shell_commands_self_reported.command: ls -la docs 2>&1; echo "---"; find docs -type f -name '*.md' 2>/dev/null | LC_ALL=C sort

[ -d out ] && echo "out exists" || echo "out missing"; find docs -type l 2>/dev/null | head; echo "--- hashes"; for f in $(find docs -type f -name '*.md' | LC_ALL=C sort); do h=$(shasum -a 256 "$f" | awk '{print $1}'); s=$(stat -f %z "$f"); l=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$f"); printf '%s  %s  %s  %s\n' "$

ls -ld out; echo "--- symlinks under docs:"; find docs -type l; echo "--- per-file:"; find docs -type f -name '*.md' | LC_ALL=C sort | while IFS= read -r f; do shasum -a 256 "$f" | awk -v sz="$(stat -f %z "$f")" -v ln="$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$f")" -v p="$f" '{print $1"  "sz"  "ln"  "p}'; done

ls -ld out; find docs -type l; shasum -a 256 docs/api/endpoints.md docs/api/overview.md docs/changelog.md docs/configuration.md docs/faq.md docs/getting-started.md docs/guides/deploy.md docs/guides/troubleshooting.md docs/index.md docs/install.md; stat -f '%z %N' docs/api/endpoints.md docs/api/overv

shasum -a 256 docs/api/endpoints.md docs/api/overview.md docs/changelog.md docs/configuration.md docs/faq.md docs/getting-started.md docs/guides/deploy.md docs/guides/troubleshooting.md docs/index.md docs/install.md

stat -f '%z %N' docs/api/endpoints.md docs/api/overview.md docs/changelog.md docs/configuration.md docs/faq.md docs/getting-started.md docs/guides/deploy.md docs/guides/troubleshooting.md docs/index.md docs/install.md

stat -f '%z %N' docs/api/endpoints.md docs/api/overview.md docs/changelog.md docs/configuration.md docs/faq.md docs/getting-started.md docs/guides/deploy.md docs/guides/troubleshooting.md docs/index.md docs/install.md
